entities.name: Kolli
entities.description: 14-year-old city girl hired as a thief, later turned into a lycanthrope.

entities.name: Dason
entities.description: Told Kolli that Morl was hiring.

entities.name: Morl
entities.description: Fur trapper who hired Kolli and was killed by Kalenth Ush.

entities.name: Kalenth Ush
entities.description: Keldon fur trapper who raised silver wolves, bit Kolli, and was killed by her.

entities.name: Keldon
entities.description: City outside whose gates Kalenth Ush lived.

events.summary: Kolli is hired by Morl to find where Kalenth Ush gets his silver wolf hide.
events.quote: Morl agreed to pay her if she could discover where the Keldon fur trapper Kalenth Ush was obtaining silver wolf hide from.

events.summary: Kalenth Ush ambushes Kolli, takes her hostage and bites her, turning her into a lycanthrope.
events.quote: Then, he bit her and turned her into a lycanthrope .

events.summary: Kalenth Ush kills Morl, and Kolli avenges him by killing Kalenth Ush.
events.quote: Kolli avenged Morl's death by killing Kalenth Ush

relations.quote: Kalenth Ush had followed her and killed Morl immediately.
Kolli avenged Morl's death by killing Kalenth Ush
